voiceContract.note: Fiezel mengajar dalam bahasa Indonesia melalui bundle neural Indonesia. Bahasa Inggris tetap menjadi materi target, contoh, prompt, dan latihan. Tidak ada browser-TTS fallback.

board.title: Articles
board.formula: a + consonant sound · an + vowel sound · the = known
examples: The pen is on the table.

segments.en: I have a pen. She is an engineer.
segments.id: A dan an dipakai untuk benda tunggal yang belum tentu diketahui pendengar.

segments.en: A book, a car, an apple, an hour.
segments.id: Pilih an kalau kata berikutnya dimulai bunyi vokal. Yang menentukan bunyinya, bukan hurufnya.

segments.en: The pen is on the table.
segments.id: The dipakai kalau pendengar sudah tahu benda mana yang dimaksud.

segments.en: I bought a book. The book is about English.
segments.id: Pola yang sering muncul: sebutkan pertama dengan a, sesudah itu pakai the.

questions.prompt: Complete: She is ___ engineer.

explain.en: Engineer starts with a vowel sound, so we use an.
explain.id: Engineer diawali bunyi vokal, jadi memakai an.

remediate.en: Listen to the first sound, not the first letter.
remediate.id: Dengarkan bunyi pertamanya, bukan huruf pertamanya.

questions.prompt: Complete: I bought a book. ___ book is new.

explain.en: The book is already known from the first sentence, so it takes the.
explain.id: Bukunya sudah diketahui dari kalimat pertama, jadi memakai the.

remediate.en: Second mention of the same thing takes the.
remediate.id: Penyebutan kedua untuk benda yang sama memakai the.

questions.prompt: Which is correct?

explain.en: University starts with a you sound, which is a consonant sound, so a is correct.
explain.id: University diawali bunyi you yang termasuk bunyi konsonan, jadi a yang benar.

remediate.en: Say the word aloud and listen to its first sound.
remediate.id: Ucapkan katanya dan dengarkan bunyi pertamanya.

board.title: Can
board.formula: can + base verb · cannot / can't + base verb

segments.en: I can swim. She can speak English.
segments.id: Can dipakai untuk menyatakan kemampuan.

segments.en: Can is always followed by the base verb.
segments.id: Setelah can, kata kerja selalu bentuk dasar. Tidak ada tambahan s dan tidak ada to.

segments.en: She cannot drive. She can't drive.
segments.id: Bentuk negatifnya cannot, atau disingkat can't.

segments.en: Can you help me, please?
segments.id: Can juga dipakai untuk meminta tolong dengan sopan.

questions.prompt: Complete: She can ___ English.

explain.en: After can the verb has no s and no to.
explain.id: Setelah can, kata kerja tanpa s dan tanpa to.

remediate.en: Can is a helper, so the main verb stays plain.
remediate.id: Can adalah kata bantu, jadi kata kerja utamanya tetap polos.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

explain.en: Can never takes s and is never followed by to.
explain.id: Can tidak pernah memakai s dan tidak pernah diikuti to.

remediate.en: Modal verbs do not change with the subject.
remediate.id: Kata kerja modal tidak berubah mengikuti subjek.

questions.prompt: What does I can't cook mean?
options: I am not able to cook.

explain.en: Can't is the negative of can: not able.
explain.id: Can't adalah bentuk negatif dari can: tidak bisa.

remediate.en: Can't is a short form of cannot.
remediate.id: Can't adalah singkatan dari cannot.

board.title: Have got
board.formula: I / you / we / they have got · he / she / it has got
examples: She has got a new phone.

segments.en: I have got two sisters. She has got a new phone.
segments.id: Have got dipakai untuk kepemilikan, dan sangat umum dalam percakapan.

segments.en: He, she and it use has got.
segments.id: Sama seperti tadi, orang ketiga tunggal memakai bentuk berbeda, yaitu has.

segments.en: I have not got a car. She has not got time.
segments.id: Bentuk negatifnya menyisipkan not di antara have dan got.

segments.en: Have you got a pen? Has he got a car?
segments.id: Untuk bertanya, pindahkan have atau has ke depan subjek.

questions.prompt: Complete: She ___ got a new phone.

explain.en: She takes has got.
explain.id: She memakai has got.

remediate.en: He, she and it always take has.
remediate.id: He, she, dan it selalu memakai has.

questions.prompt: Which question is correct?
options: Do you have got a pen?

explain.en: Have moves in front of the subject to ask.
explain.id: Have pindah ke depan subjek untuk bertanya.

remediate.en: Do is not used together with have got.
remediate.id: Do tidak dipakai bersama have got.

questions.prompt: Complete: They ___ got any money.

explain.en: They is plural, so have not got is correct.
explain.id: They itu jamak, jadi have not got yang benar.

remediate.en: Not sits between have and got.
remediate.id: Not berada di antara have dan got.

board.title: Past Simple
board.formula: verb + ed · did not + base verb

segments.en: I worked yesterday. She studied last night.
segments.id: Past simple dipakai untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai di masa lampau.

segments.en: Most regular verbs just add ed.
segments.id: Sebagian besar kata kerja beraturan hanya menambahkan ed.

segments.en: Study becomes studied. Stop becomes stopped.
segments.id: Ada penyesuaian ejaan: y berubah jadi ied, dan konsonan akhir kadang digandakan.

segments.en: I did not work. Did you work yesterday?
segments.id: Dalam bentuk negatif dan pertanyaan, did yang membawa masa lampau, jadi kata kerjanya kembali ke bentuk dasar.

questions.prompt: What is the past of study?

explain.en: Consonant plus y becomes ied.
explain.id: Konsonan lalu y berubah menjadi ied.

remediate.en: Change y to i before ed.
remediate.id: Ubah y menjadi i sebelum ed.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

explain.en: Did already marks the past, so the verb stays in the base form.
explain.id: Did sudah menandai masa lampau, jadi kata kerjanya tetap bentuk dasar.

remediate.en: Only one word carries the past tense.
remediate.id: Hanya satu kata yang membawa penanda lampau.

questions.prompt: Complete: They ___ football yesterday.

explain.en: Yesterday signals the past, so we add ed.
explain.id: Kata yesterday menandakan lampau, jadi tambahkan ed.

remediate.en: Look for a past time word in the sentence.
remediate.id: Cari kata penanda waktu lampau dalam kalimatnya.

board.title: Was · Were
board.formula: I / he / she / it was · you / we / they were

segments.en: I was at home yesterday. They were at school.
segments.id: Was dan were adalah bentuk lampau dari to be.

segments.en: I was, he was, she was, it was. You were, we were, they were.
segments.id: I dan orang ketiga tunggal memakai was. Sisanya memakai were.

segments.en: I was not tired. They were not late.
segments.id: Bentuk negatifnya menambahkan not sesudah was atau were.

segments.en: Was she happy? Were you at home?
segments.id: Untuk bertanya, pindahkan was atau were ke depan subjek.

questions.prompt: Complete: They ___ at school yesterday.

explain.en: They is plural, so were is correct.
explain.id: They itu jamak, jadi were yang benar.

remediate.en: Plural subjects take were.
remediate.id: Subjek jamak memakai were.

questions.prompt: Complete: She ___ very tired last night.

explain.en: She takes was in the past.
explain.id: She memakai was untuk bentuk lampau.

remediate.en: I, he, she and it take was.
remediate.id: I, he, she, dan it memakai was.

questions.prompt: Which question is correct?

explain.en: Were moves in front of the subject.
explain.id: Were pindah ke depan subjek.

remediate.en: Did is never used together with was or were.
remediate.id: Did tidak pernah dipakai bersama was atau were.

board.title: Plurals
board.formula: book → books · box → boxes · child → children

segments.en: One book, two books. One car, two cars.
segments.id: Bentuk jamak paling umum hanya menambahkan huruf s.

segments.en: One box, two boxes. One watch, two watches.
segments.id: Kalau kata berakhir dengan s, x, ch, sh, atau o, tambahkan es.

segments.en: City becomes cities. Baby becomes babies.
segments.id: Kalau berakhir konsonan lalu y, ubah y menjadi i lalu tambahkan es.

segments.en: Man becomes men. Child becomes children.
segments.id: Beberapa kata tidak beraturan dan harus dihafal.

questions.prompt: What is the plural of box?

explain.en: Words ending in x take es.
explain.id: Kata yang berakhir x memakai es.

remediate.en: After s, x, ch and sh we add es.
remediate.id: Setelah s, x, ch, dan sh kita tambahkan es.

questions.prompt: What is the plural of city?

explain.en: Consonant plus y becomes ies.
explain.id: Konsonan lalu y berubah menjadi ies.

remediate.en: Change y to i, then add es.
remediate.id: Ubah y menjadi i, lalu tambahkan es.

questions.prompt: What is the plural of child?

explain.en: Child is irregular: the plural is children.
explain.id: Child tidak beraturan: bentuk jamaknya children.

remediate.en: Some very common nouns do not follow the s rule.
remediate.id: Beberapa kata benda umum tidak mengikuti aturan s.

board.title: In · On · At (place)
board.formula: in a space · on a surface · at a point
examples: The keys are in the bag.
The book is on the table.
I am at the bus stop.

segments.en: The keys are in the bag.
segments.id: In dipakai untuk sesuatu yang berada di dalam ruang atau wadah.

segments.en: The book is on the table.
segments.id: On dipakai untuk sesuatu yang menempel pada permukaan.

segments.en: I am at the bus stop. She is at school.
segments.id: At dipakai untuk satu titik atau tempat kegiatan.

segments.en: In the room, on the wall, at the door.
segments.id: Ingat tiga gambarannya: di dalam, di permukaan, dan di satu titik.

questions.prompt: Complete: The book is ___ the table.

explain.en: A table is a surface, so we use on.
explain.id: Meja adalah permukaan, jadi memakai on.

remediate.en: Ask if it is inside, on a surface, or at a point.
remediate.id: Tanyakan apakah di dalam, di permukaan, atau di satu titik.

questions.prompt: Complete: My phone is ___ my bag.

explain.en: A bag is a container, so we use in.
explain.id: Tas adalah wadah, jadi memakai in.

remediate.en: Inside something is always in.
remediate.id: Berada di dalam sesuatu selalu memakai in.

questions.prompt: Complete: I am waiting ___ the bus stop.

explain.en: A bus stop is treated as a point, so we use at.
explain.id: Halte dianggap satu titik, jadi memakai at.

remediate.en: A specific meeting point takes at.
remediate.id: Titik pertemuan yang spesifik memakai at.

board.title: In · On · At (time)
board.formula: in months/years · on days/dates · at clock times

segments.en: In July, in 2026, in the morning.
segments.id: In dipakai untuk bulan, tahun, dan bagian hari.

segments.en: On Monday, on 3 May, on my birthday.
segments.id: On dipakai untuk hari dan tanggal.

segments.en: At seven o'clock, at night, at the weekend.
segments.id: At dipakai untuk jam dan beberapa ungkapan tetap.

segments.en: Notice: in the morning, but at night.
segments.id: Perhatikan satu pengecualian penting: in the morning, tetapi at night.

questions.prompt: Complete: The class starts ___ eight o'clock.

explain.en: Clock times take at.
explain.id: Waktu jam memakai at.

remediate.en: A clock time is always at.
remediate.id: Waktu jam selalu memakai at.

questions.prompt: Complete: My birthday is ___ May.

explain.en: Months take in.
explain.id: Nama bulan memakai in.

remediate.en: Months and years take in.
remediate.id: Bulan dan tahun memakai in.

questions.prompt: Complete: We have English ___ Monday.

explain.en: Days of the week take on.
explain.id: Nama hari memakai on.

remediate.en: Days and dates take on.
remediate.id: Hari dan tanggal memakai on.

board.title: Present Continuous
board.formula: am / is / are + verb-ing

segments.en: I am studying now. She is cooking dinner.
segments.id: Present continuous dipakai untuk kejadian yang sedang berlangsung sekarang.

segments.en: The pattern is be plus verb plus ing.
segments.id: Polanya adalah to be, lalu kata kerja ditambah ing. Keduanya harus ada.

segments.en: I work every day, but today I am studying.
segments.id: Bandingkan dengan present simple: work adalah kebiasaan, am studying adalah sekarang.

segments.en: Are you listening? She is not sleeping.
segments.id: Bertanya dan menyangkal dilakukan lewat to be, bukan lewat kata kerja utama.

questions.prompt: Complete: She ___ dinner now.

explain.en: Now signals an action in progress, so we use is cooking.
explain.id: Kata now menandakan aksi yang sedang berjalan, jadi memakai is cooking.

remediate.en: Present continuous always needs be plus ing.
remediate.id: Present continuous selalu butuh to be dan ing.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

explain.en: Both parts are required: am and studying.
explain.id: Kedua bagian wajib ada: am dan studying.

remediate.en: Do not drop be, and do not drop ing.
remediate.id: Jangan menghilangkan to be, dan jangan menghilangkan ing.

questions.prompt: Which sentence describes a habit, not now?

explain.en: Present simple describes a habit; continuous describes right now.
explain.id: Present simple menggambarkan kebiasaan; continuous menggambarkan saat ini.

remediate.en: Ask yourself: every day, or at this moment?
remediate.id: Tanyakan pada dirimu: setiap hari, atau saat ini?

board.title: Present Simple
board.formula: I / you / we / they work · he / she / it works
examples: He does not work on Sunday.

segments.en: I work in Bandung. She works in a bank.
segments.id: Present simple dipakai untuk kebiasaan dan fakta.

segments.en: He, she and it add s to the verb.
segments.id: Jebakan terbesarnya ada di orang ketiga tunggal: kata kerjanya ditambah s.

segments.en: He does not work on Sunday. They do not work at night.
segments.id: Untuk bentuk negatif, pakai do not atau does not, lalu kata kerja dasar tanpa s.

segments.en: Do you work here? Does she work here?
segments.id: Untuk bertanya, mulai dengan do atau does. Kata kerjanya kembali ke bentuk dasar.

questions.prompt: Complete: She ___ in a bank.

explain.en: She is third person singular, so the verb takes s.
explain.id: She itu orang ketiga tunggal, jadi kata kerjanya ditambah s.

remediate.en: He, she and it add s in the present simple.
remediate.id: He, she, dan it menambahkan s pada present simple.

questions.prompt: Complete: He ___ not like coffee.

explain.en: With he we use does not, and the verb stays in its base form.
explain.id: Dengan he kita memakai does not, dan kata kerjanya tetap bentuk dasar.

remediate.en: Does already carries the s, so the verb does not.
remediate.id: Does sudah membawa s, jadi kata kerjanya tidak lagi memakai s.

questions.prompt: Which question is correct?

explain.en: After does the verb returns to its base form: work.
explain.id: Setelah does, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: work.

remediate.en: Never put s on the verb after does.
remediate.id: Jangan menambahkan s pada kata kerja setelah does.

board.title: Pronouns
board.formula: I · you · he · she · it · we · they

segments.en: I, you, he, she, it, we, they.
segments.id: Ini kata ganti subjek. Dipakai di depan kata kerja.

segments.en: My, your, his, her, its, our, their.
segments.id: Ini kata ganti kepemilikan. Selalu diikuti kata benda, misalnya my book.

segments.en: This is my book. This book is mine.
segments.id: Perhatikan bedanya. My selalu bersama kata benda, sedangkan mine berdiri sendiri.

segments.en: Her name is Sari. His name is Dani.
segments.id: Dalam bahasa Inggris, kepemilikan mengikuti pemiliknya, bukan bendanya.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ name is Sari.

explain.en: Before a noun we use the possessive adjective her.
explain.id: Sebelum kata benda kita memakai kata kepemilikan her.

remediate.en: A word before a noun must be my, your, his, her, our or their.
remediate.id: Kata sebelum kata benda harus my, your, his, her, our, atau their.

questions.prompt: Complete: That bag is ___.

explain.en: With no noun after it, we use mine.
explain.id: Kalau tidak ada kata benda sesudahnya, kita memakai mine.

remediate.en: My needs a noun; mine stands alone.
remediate.id: My butuh kata benda; mine berdiri sendiri.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

explain.en: The subject of the sentence is I.
explain.id: Subjek kalimatnya adalah I.

remediate.en: Use I as the subject, me as the object.
remediate.id: Pakai I sebagai subjek, me sebagai objek.

board.title: Wh- questions
board.formula: what · where · when · who · why · how

segments.en: What, where, when, who, why, how.
segments.id: Enam kata tanya ini menutup hampir semua kebutuhan percakapan dasar.

segments.en: What is your name? Where do you live?
segments.id: What menanyakan benda atau informasi, where menanyakan tempat.

segments.en: When do you study? Who is your teacher? Why are you late?
segments.id: When menanyakan waktu, who menanyakan orang, dan why menanyakan alasan.

segments.en: How old are you? How much is it?
segments.id: How sering berpasangan dengan kata lain, misalnya how old dan how much.

questions.prompt: Which question asks about a place?

explain.en: Where asks about place.
explain.id: Where menanyakan tempat.

remediate.en: Match the question word to the information you need.
remediate.id: Cocokkan kata tanya dengan informasi yang kamu butuhkan.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ old are you?

explain.en: Age is asked with how old.
explain.id: Umur ditanyakan dengan how old.

remediate.en: How combines with other words: how old, how much, how many.
remediate.id: How berpasangan dengan kata lain: how old, how much, how many.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ is your teacher?

explain.en: Who asks about a person.
explain.id: Who menanyakan orang.

remediate.en: A person is always who.
remediate.id: Untuk orang selalu memakai who.

board.title: Some · Any
board.formula: some in positives · any in negatives and questions

segments.en: I have some water. I have some friends here.
segments.id: Some dipakai dalam kalimat positif, untuk jumlah yang tidak disebut pasti.

segments.en: I do not have any money. Do you have any questions?
segments.id: Any dipakai dalam kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan.

segments.en: Countable: one book, two books. Uncountable: water, rice, money.
segments.id: Kata benda terhitung bisa dihitung satu per satu; kata benda tak terhitung tidak bisa.

segments.en: How many books? How much water?
segments.id: Untuk yang terhitung pakai how many, untuk yang tak terhitung pakai how much.

questions.prompt: Complete: I don't have ___ money.

explain.en: Negatives take any.
explain.id: Kalimat negatif memakai any.

remediate.en: Some is for positive sentences.
remediate.id: Some dipakai untuk kalimat positif.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ many books do you have?

explain.en: Books are countable, so we use how many.
explain.id: Books bisa dihitung, jadi memakai how many.

remediate.en: Countable nouns take how many.
remediate.id: Kata benda terhitung memakai how many.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

explain.en: Water is uncountable, so it has no plural and no a.
explain.id: Water tidak terhitung, jadi tanpa bentuk jamak dan tanpa a.

remediate.en: Uncountable nouns stay singular.
remediate.id: Kata benda tak terhitung tetap tunggal.

board.title: There is · There are
board.formula: There is + singular · There are + plural
examples: There is a book on the desk.
Is there a bank near here?

segments.en: There is a book on the desk.
segments.id: There is dipakai untuk menyatakan ada, dengan benda tunggal.

segments.en: There are two books on the desk.
segments.id: Untuk benda jamak, gunakan there are.

segments.en: There is not any milk. There are not any chairs.
segments.id: Bentuk negatifnya menambahkan not, dan sering dipakai bersama any.

segments.en: Is there a bank near here? Are there any questions?
segments.id: Untuk bertanya, pindahkan is atau are ke depan there.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ three chairs in the room.

explain.en: Three chairs is plural, so we use there are.
explain.id: Three chairs itu jamak, jadi memakai there are.

remediate.en: Count the noun first, then choose is or are.
remediate.id: Hitung benda dulu, baru pilih is atau are.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ a bank near here?

explain.en: Questions move is in front of there.
explain.id: Dalam pertanyaan, is pindah ke depan there.

remediate.en: Ask with Is there or Are there.
remediate.id: Bertanya dengan Is there atau Are there.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

explain.en: People is plural here, so there are is correct.
explain.id: People di sini jamak, jadi there are yang benar.

remediate.en: There have is never used to say something exists.
remediate.id: There have tidak pernah dipakai untuk menyatakan keberadaan.

board.title: To be
board.formula: I am · you/we/they are · he/she/it is

segments.en: I am a student. She is my teacher. They are from Bandung.
segments.id: Kita mulai dari kata kerja paling dasar dalam bahasa Inggris, yaitu to be.

segments.en: I am, you are, he is, she is, it is, we are, they are.
segments.id: Bentuknya mengikuti subjek. I memakai am, he, she, dan it memakai is, sisanya memakai are.

segments.en: I am not tired. She is not late.
segments.id: Untuk bentuk negatif, tambahkan not sesudah to be. Bukan sebelum.

segments.en: Are you ready? Is she a doctor?
segments.id: Untuk bertanya, tukar posisinya. To be pindah ke depan subjek.

questions.prompt: Complete: She ___ my sister.

explain.en: He, she and it always take is.
explain.id: He, she, dan it selalu memakai is.

remediate.en: Look at the subject first, then choose the form of be.
remediate.id: Lihat subjeknya dulu, baru pilih bentuk to be.

questions.prompt: Complete: They ___ from Jakarta.

explain.en: They is plural, so it takes are.
explain.id: They itu jamak, jadi memakai are.

remediate.en: Plural subjects take are.
remediate.id: Subjek jamak memakai are.

questions.prompt: Which question is correct?

explain.en: In a question be moves in front of the subject: Are you ready?
explain.id: Dalam pertanyaan, to be pindah ke depan subjek: Are you ready?

remediate.en: Move am, is or are before the subject to ask.
remediate.id: Pindahkan am, is, atau are ke depan subjek untuk bertanya.

board.title: Present Perfect
board.formula: Subject + have / has + V3

segments.en: Let's look at the present perfect.
segments.id: Mari kita lihat present perfect.

segments.en: The basic pattern is subject, have or has,
segments.id: Polanya adalah subjek, have atau has,

segments.en: then the past participle, the third form of the verb.
segments.id: lalu past participle atau kata kerja bentuk ketiga.

segments.en: We use it when the time is not important, only the result.
segments.id: Kita memakainya saat waktunya tidak penting, hanya hasilnya.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

explain.en: Gone is the past participle. Went is the simple past, so it cannot follow have.
explain.id: Gone adalah past participle. Went itu simple past, jadi tidak bisa mengikuti have.

remediate.en: Remember: have or has is always followed by the third form.
remediate.id: Ingat: have atau has selalu diikuti bentuk ketiga.

questions.prompt: Complete: She ___ finished her project.

explain.en: She is third person singular, so we use has.
explain.id: She itu orang ketiga tunggal, jadi memakai has.

remediate.en: He, she and it always take has, not have.
remediate.id: He, she, dan it selalu memakai has, bukan have.

board.title: Clothes and colours
board.formula: a red shirt · wear · a pair of

segments.en: Shirt, trousers, dress, jacket, shoes.
segments.id: Ini nama pakaian yang paling sering dipakai sehari-hari.

segments.en: Red, blue, green, black, white.
segments.id: Warna diletakkan sebelum kata bendanya, misalnya a red shirt.

segments.en: She is wearing a blue jacket today.
segments.id: Kata kerjanya adalah wear. Untuk sekarang, gunakan is wearing.

segments.en: A pair of shoes, a pair of trousers.
segments.id: Benda yang berpasangan dihitung dengan a pair of.

questions.prompt: Which order is correct?

explain.en: The colour comes before the noun.
explain.id: Warna diletakkan sebelum kata benda.

remediate.en: Adjective first, then the noun.
remediate.id: Kata sifat dulu, baru kata benda.

questions.prompt: Complete: She is ___ a jacket.

explain.en: For clothes on the body we use wear.
explain.id: Untuk pakaian yang sedang dikenakan, kita memakai wear.

remediate.en: Wear is the verb for clothes.
remediate.id: Wear adalah kata kerja untuk pakaian.

questions.prompt: Complete: I bought a ___ of shoes.

explain.en: Shoes come in twos, so we say a pair of shoes.
explain.id: Sepatu berpasangan, jadi kita berkata a pair of shoes.

remediate.en: Two-part items take a pair of.
remediate.id: Benda berpasangan memakai a pair of.

board.title: Daily routine
board.formula: get up · have breakfast · go to work
examples: I go to bed at ten.

segments.en: I get up at six o'clock. I have breakfast at seven.
segments.id: Rutinitas harian selalu memakai present simple, karena ini kebiasaan.

segments.en: Get up, take a shower, have breakfast, go to work.
segments.id: Kata kerja rutinitas biasanya berpasangan dengan kata lain, jadi hafalkan pasangannya.

segments.en: Always, usually, often, sometimes, never.
segments.id: Kata keterangan frekuensi ini diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama.

segments.en: I always get up early. I am never late.
segments.id: Perhatikan satu pengecualian: dengan to be, kata frekuensi diletakkan sesudahnya.

questions.prompt: Complete: I ___ up at six every day.

explain.en: Every day signals a habit, so present simple is correct.
explain.id: Every day menandakan kebiasaan, jadi present simple yang benar.

remediate.en: Habits use the present simple.
remediate.id: Kebiasaan memakai present simple.

questions.prompt: Where does always go?

explain.en: Frequency adverbs sit before the main verb.
explain.id: Kata keterangan frekuensi berada sebelum kata kerja utama.

remediate.en: Before the main verb, after be.
remediate.id: Sebelum kata kerja utama, sesudah to be.

questions.prompt: Which phrase is correct?

explain.en: The fixed phrase is have breakfast.
explain.id: Frasa tetapnya adalah have breakfast.

remediate.en: Learn routine verbs together with their partner word.
remediate.id: Hafalkan kata kerja rutinitas bersama pasangan katanya.

board.title: Family
board.formula: parents · siblings · relatives

segments.en: Mother and father together are parents.
segments.id: Ibu dan ayah bersama-sama disebut parents.

segments.en: Brother and sister together are siblings.
segments.id: Kakak atau adik laki-laki dan perempuan bersama-sama disebut siblings.

segments.en: My father's brother is my uncle. His daughter is my cousin.
segments.id: Cousin dipakai untuk sepupu, laki-laki maupun perempuan.

segments.en: This is my wife. This is my husband.
segments.id: Untuk pasangan, gunakan wife untuk istri dan husband untuk suami.

questions.prompt: Your mother's sister is your…

explain.en: Your mother's sister is your aunt.
explain.id: Saudara perempuan ibumu adalah aunt.

remediate.en: Aunt is the sister of a parent.
remediate.id: Aunt adalah saudara perempuan dari orang tua.

questions.prompt: Brother and sister together are…

explain.en: Siblings covers brothers and sisters.
explain.id: Siblings mencakup saudara laki-laki dan perempuan.

remediate.en: Parents means mother and father.
remediate.id: Parents berarti ibu dan ayah.

questions.prompt: Which word means the child of your uncle?

explain.en: The child of an uncle or aunt is a cousin.
explain.id: Anak dari paman atau bibi adalah cousin.

remediate.en: Cousin is used for both boys and girls.
remediate.id: Cousin dipakai untuk laki-laki maupun perempuan.

board.title: Food
board.formula: countable food · uncountable food · a cup of…

segments.en: An apple, a banana, two eggs.
segments.id: Sebagian makanan bisa dihitung satu per satu.

segments.en: Rice, bread, water, coffee.
segments.id: Sebagian lagi tidak bisa dihitung langsung, jadi tidak memakai bentuk jamak.

segments.en: A cup of tea, a glass of water, a bowl of rice.
segments.id: Untuk menghitung yang tak terhitung, gunakan wadahnya: a cup of, a glass of, a bowl of.

segments.en: I would like a coffee, please. Can I have the bill?
segments.id: Dua kalimat ini paling sering dipakai saat memesan makanan.

questions.prompt: Which is correct?

explain.en: Rice is uncountable, so we count the container.
explain.id: Rice tidak terhitung, jadi yang dihitung wadahnya.

remediate.en: Use a cup, glass or bowl to count uncountable food.
remediate.id: Pakai cup, glass, atau bowl untuk menghitung makanan tak terhitung.

questions.prompt: Complete: I would like ___ glass of water.

explain.en: Glass starts with a consonant sound, so a is correct.
explain.id: Glass diawali bunyi konsonan, jadi a yang benar.

remediate.en: Choose a or an by the sound of the next word.
remediate.id: Pilih a atau an berdasarkan bunyi kata berikutnya.

questions.prompt: Which sentence orders food politely?
options: I would like a coffee, please.

explain.en: Would like plus please is the polite form.
explain.id: Would like ditambah please adalah bentuk sopan.

remediate.en: Polite ordering uses would like, not give me.
remediate.id: Memesan dengan sopan memakai would like, bukan give me.

board.title: Jobs
board.formula: I am a + job · work as · work in / at

segments.en: I am a teacher. She is a nurse. He is an engineer.
segments.id: Untuk menyebut pekerjaan, gunakan to be lalu a atau an.

segments.en: A doctor works in a hospital. A teacher works in a school.
segments.id: Sebutkan tempat kerjanya dengan work in atau work at.

segments.en: She works as a nurse.
segments.id: Work as dipakai untuk menyebut peran atau jabatannya.

segments.en: What do you do? I am a student.
segments.id: What do you do adalah cara umum menanyakan pekerjaan seseorang.

questions.prompt: Complete: I am ___ engineer.

explain.en: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so an is used.
explain.id: Engineer diawali bunyi vokal, jadi memakai an.

remediate.en: Job words after be always need a or an.
remediate.id: Kata pekerjaan setelah to be selalu butuh a atau an.

questions.prompt: Where does a nurse work?

explain.en: A nurse works in a hospital.
explain.id: Perawat bekerja di rumah sakit.

remediate.en: Match the job to its usual workplace.
remediate.id: Cocokkan pekerjaan dengan tempat kerjanya yang biasa.

questions.prompt: What does What do you do? ask about?

explain.en: It asks about your job.
explain.id: Pertanyaan itu menanyakan pekerjaanmu.

remediate.en: It is the standard way to ask about work.
remediate.id: Itu cara baku untuk menanyakan pekerjaan.

board.title: Numbers and time
board.formula: thirteen ≠ thirty · half past · on 3 May

segments.en: One, two, three… thirteen, fourteen, fifteen.
segments.id: Kita mulai dari angka, karena hampir semua percakapan dasar memakainya.

segments.en: Thirteen and thirty sound similar but are very different numbers.
segments.id: Hati-hati dengan pasangan teen dan ty. Thirteen tiga belas, thirty tiga puluh. Tekanannya berbeda.

segments.en: It is seven o'clock. It is half past seven. It is a quarter to eight.
segments.id: Untuk jam, pakai o'clock, half past untuk lewat tiga puluh menit, dan quarter untuk lima belas menit.

segments.en: My birthday is on the third of May, nineteen ninety-nine.
segments.id: Tanggal dibaca dengan bilangan tingkat, dan tahun dibaca berpasangan.

questions.prompt: Which number is 30?

explain.en: Thirty is 30; thirteen is 13.
explain.id: Thirty itu 30; thirteen itu 13.

remediate.en: Listen to the ending: teen or ty.
remediate.id: Dengarkan akhirannya: teen atau ty.

questions.prompt: What time is 7:30?

explain.en: Thirty minutes after seven is half past seven.
explain.id: Tiga puluh menit setelah pukul tujuh adalah half past seven.

remediate.en: Half past means thirty minutes after the hour.
remediate.id: Half past berarti tiga puluh menit setelah jam itu.

questions.prompt: Which date is correct?

explain.en: Dates take on.
explain.id: Tanggal memakai on.

remediate.en: Days and dates always take on.
remediate.id: Hari dan tanggal selalu memakai on.

board.title: Places and directions
board.formula: go straight · turn left · next to
examples: The bank is next to the school.

segments.en: Bank, market, hospital, school, station, post office.
segments.id: Ini tempat-tempat yang paling sering muncul saat bertanya arah.

segments.en: Go straight. Turn left. Turn right.
segments.id: Tiga perintah arah ini sudah cukup untuk sebagian besar situasi.

segments.en: The bank is next to the school, opposite the market.
segments.id: Next to berarti di sebelah, opposite berarti di seberang.

segments.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
segments.id: Kalimat ini pembuka yang sopan saat bertanya arah kepada orang asing.

questions.prompt: What does next to mean?

explain.en: Next to means beside, right at the side.
explain.id: Next to berarti di sebelah, tepat di sampingnya.

remediate.en: Next to is about position at the side.
remediate.id: Next to berkaitan dengan posisi di samping.

questions.prompt: Complete: Go ___, then turn left.

explain.en: Go straight means continue forward.
explain.id: Go straight berarti terus lurus ke depan.

remediate.en: Straight means without turning.
remediate.id: Straight berarti tanpa berbelok.

questions.prompt: Which question asks for a place politely?
options: Excuse me, where is the station?

explain.en: Excuse me opens the question politely and the word order is correct.
explain.id: Excuse me membuka pertanyaan dengan sopan dan urutan katanya benar.

remediate.en: Keep the order: where is the plus place.
remediate.id: Pertahankan urutannya: where is the lalu tempatnya.

board.title: Weather
board.formula: It is + adjective · rainy season

segments.en: It is hot. It is cold. It is windy.
segments.id: Untuk cuaca, kalimat selalu dimulai dengan it is.

segments.en: It is raining now. It rains a lot in December.
segments.id: Rain bisa menjadi kata kerja. Sekarang memakai is raining, kebiasaan memakai rains.

segments.en: Sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy.
segments.id: Akhiran y mengubah kata benda cuaca menjadi kata sifat.

segments.en: In Indonesia there are two seasons: the dry season and the rainy season.
segments.id: Di Indonesia ada dua musim, jadi kosakata inilah yang paling sering kamu butuhkan.

questions.prompt: Complete: ___ hot today.

explain.en: Weather sentences begin with it is.
explain.id: Kalimat cuaca dimulai dengan it is.

remediate.en: Weather always uses it as the subject.
remediate.id: Cuaca selalu memakai it sebagai subjek.

questions.prompt: Which word describes a day with a lot of sun?

explain.en: Sunny describes a lot of sun.
explain.id: Sunny menggambarkan banyak sinar matahari.

remediate.en: Add y to the weather noun to describe the day.
remediate.id: Tambahkan y pada kata benda cuaca untuk menggambarkan harinya.

questions.prompt: Complete: It ___ a lot in December.

explain.en: It is third person singular, so the verb takes s.
explain.id: It itu orang ketiga tunggal, jadi kata kerjanya ditambah s.

remediate.en: A repeated fact uses the present simple.
remediate.id: Fakta yang berulang memakai present simple.

board.title: Word Family
board.formula: decide → decision → decisive

segments.en: A word family is one root in different forms.
segments.id: Word family adalah satu akar kata dalam bentuk berbeda.

segments.en: Decide is the verb, decision is the noun, decisive is the adjective.
segments.id: Decide itu kata kerja, decision kata benda, decisive kata sifat.

segments.en: Knowing the family lets you say the same idea in many ways.
segments.id: Menguasai satu keluarga kata membuatmu bisa mengungkapkan ide yang sama dengan banyak cara.

questions.prompt: Choose the noun form of 'decide'.

explain.en: Decision is the noun. Decisive is an adjective.
explain.id: Decision adalah kata benda. Decisive adalah kata sifat.

remediate.en: Nouns often end in -sion or -tion.
remediate.id: Kata benda sering berakhiran -sion atau -tion.

board.title: Personal profile
board.formula: name · age · job · city

segments.en: My name is Rina. I am twenty-two years old. I live in Bandung and I work in a hospital.
segments.id: Teks profil selalu berisi empat informasi: nama, umur, tempat tinggal, dan pekerjaan.

segments.en: Read for the four facts first, not for every word.
segments.id: Baca untuk mencari empat fakta itu dulu, jangan menerjemahkan setiap kata.

segments.en: I live in Bandung tells you the city. I work in a hospital tells you the job.
segments.id: Kata live menandai tempat tinggal, dan kata work menandai pekerjaan.

segments.en: She is a nurse, so she works in a hospital.
segments.id: Kadang jawabannya tidak tertulis langsung, tetapi bisa disimpulkan dari kata kuncinya.

questions.prompt: Rina says: I work in a hospital. What is her job probably?

explain.en: A hospital worker in an A1 text is usually a nurse or a doctor.
explain.id: Orang yang bekerja di rumah sakit dalam teks A1 biasanya perawat atau dokter.

remediate.en: Use the workplace to guess the job.
remediate.id: Gunakan tempat kerjanya untuk menebak pekerjaannya.

questions.prompt: Which word tells you the city?

explain.en: Live in plus a place names the city.
explain.id: Live in ditambah nama tempat menunjukkan kotanya.

remediate.en: Look for live in when a question asks about place.
remediate.id: Cari kata live in kalau pertanyaannya soal tempat.

questions.prompt: How old is Rina?

explain.en: The text says twenty-two years old.
explain.id: Teksnya menyebut twenty-two years old.

remediate.en: Numbers in a profile answer the age question.
remediate.id: Angka dalam profil menjawab pertanyaan umur.

board.title: Short messages
board.formula: Hi … · Can you … ? · See you

segments.en: Hi Dani, can you come to my house at four? See you, Rina.
segments.id: Pesan pendek punya tiga bagian: sapaan, isi, dan penutup.

segments.en: The middle line always carries the request or the information.
segments.id: Bagian tengah selalu berisi permintaan atau informasi utamanya.

segments.en: Can you come at four? is a request, not a fact.
segments.id: Kalimat tanya dengan can you adalah permintaan, bukan pernyataan.

segments.en: See you, Best regards, Thanks.
segments.id: Penutup pesan bisa santai seperti see you, atau lebih formal seperti best regards.

questions.prompt: Hi Dani, can you come at four? What is Rina doing?

explain.en: Can you come is an invitation or request.
explain.id: Can you come adalah undangan atau permintaan.

remediate.en: Look at the middle line to find the purpose.
remediate.id: Lihat bagian tengah untuk menemukan tujuannya.

questions.prompt: Which is the closing of a message?

explain.en: See you plus the name closes the message.
explain.id: See you ditambah nama adalah penutup pesan.

remediate.en: The closing is the last line with the sender's name.
remediate.id: Penutup adalah baris terakhir dengan nama pengirim.

questions.prompt: Which reply accepts the invitation?

explain.en: Yes plus the time accepts the invitation.
explain.id: Yes ditambah waktunya berarti menerima undangan.

remediate.en: An acceptance repeats the time.
remediate.id: Jawaban menerima biasanya mengulang waktunya.

board.title: Signs
board.formula: no + verb-ing · open / closed · push / pull

segments.en: No smoking. No parking. No entry.
segments.id: Papan larangan sering memakai pola no ditambah kata kerja ing.

segments.en: Open 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Closed on Sunday.
segments.id: Papan jam buka memakai open dan closed dengan waktu di belakangnya.

segments.en: Push. Pull. Exit. Entrance.
segments.id: Empat kata di pintu ini wajib kamu kenali: dorong, tarik, keluar, masuk.

segments.en: Out of order means the machine does not work.
segments.id: Out of order berarti alatnya sedang rusak, bukan berarti tidak rapi.

questions.prompt: What does No parking mean?

explain.en: No plus verb-ing is a prohibition.
explain.id: No ditambah kata kerja ing adalah larangan.

remediate.en: No at the start of a sign means do not.
remediate.id: No di awal papan berarti jangan.

questions.prompt: A shop sign says Closed on Sunday. When can you visit?

explain.en: Closed on Sunday means it is open on the other days.
explain.id: Closed on Sunday berarti buka pada hari lainnya.

remediate.en: Read what the sign excludes.
remediate.id: Baca hari apa yang dikecualikan papan itu.

questions.prompt: What does Out of order mean?

explain.en: Out of order means it is not working.
explain.id: Out of order berarti sedang tidak berfungsi.

remediate.en: It is a fixed phrase about machines.
remediate.id: Itu frasa tetap tentang mesin atau alat.

board.title: Timetables
board.formula: departs · arrives · platform

segments.en: The train departs at seven fifteen and arrives at nine forty.
segments.id: Dalam jadwal, kata kuncinya adalah departs untuk berangkat dan arrives untuk tiba.

segments.en: Departs means leaves. Arrives means comes.
segments.id: Dua kata ini sering tertukar, padahal artinya berlawanan.

segments.en: Read the row first, then the column.
segments.id: Cara membaca tabel: temukan barisnya dulu, baru kolom waktunya.

segments.en: Platform 3, gate 12, seat 14A.
segments.id: Angka tempat juga penting: platform untuk kereta, gate untuk pesawat.

questions.prompt: The train departs at 07:15. What does departs mean?

explain.en: Departs means leaves.
explain.id: Departs berarti berangkat.

remediate.en: Departure is the start of a journey.
remediate.id: Departure adalah awal perjalanan.

questions.prompt: Departs 07:15, arrives 09:40. How long is the journey?

explain.en: From 07:15 to 09:40 is two hours and twenty-five minutes.
explain.id: Dari 07:15 sampai 09:40 adalah dua jam dua puluh lima menit.

remediate.en: Count the full hours first, then the minutes.
remediate.id: Hitung jam penuhnya dulu, baru menitnya.

questions.prompt: Where do you wait for a train?

explain.en: Trains are boarded from a platform.
explain.id: Kereta dinaiki dari platform.

remediate.en: Gate is for planes, platform is for trains.
remediate.id: Gate untuk pesawat, platform untuk kereta.

board.title: Main Idea
board.formula: Topic + what the writer says about it

segments.en: The main idea is what the whole paragraph is about.
segments.id: Main idea adalah inti dari keseluruhan paragraf.

segments.en: It is not one detail or one example.
segments.id: Itu bukan satu detail atau satu contoh saja.

segments.en: Ask yourself: which sentence could summarise all the others?
segments.id: Tanyakan: kalimat mana yang bisa merangkum semuanya?

questions.prompt: The main idea of a paragraph is usually:

explain.en: Every other sentence supports the main idea.
explain.id: Semua kalimat lain mendukung main idea.

remediate.en: If a sentence only appears once and adds a fact, it is a detail.
remediate.id: Kalau sebuah kalimat cuma muncul sekali dan menambah fakta, itu detail.

board.title: Instructions
board.formula: imperative verb first · please

segments.en: Open your book. Close the door. Listen and repeat.
segments.id: Kalimat instruksi selalu dimulai dengan kata kerja dasar, tanpa subjek.

segments.en: There is no subject, so the first word is the action.
segments.id: Karena tidak ada subjek, kata pertamanya adalah aksinya. Itu kunci menyimaknya.

segments.en: Please write your name at the top.
segments.id: Kata please membuatnya lebih sopan, tetapi strukturnya tetap sama.

segments.en: Don't write on this page.
segments.id: Untuk larangan, tambahkan don't di depan kata kerjanya.

questions.prompt: You hear: Open your book. What kind of sentence is it?

explain.en: A verb at the start with no subject is an instruction.
explain.id: Kata kerja di awal tanpa subjek berarti instruksi.

remediate.en: No subject plus base verb equals an imperative.
remediate.id: Tanpa subjek ditambah kata kerja dasar berarti kalimat perintah.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a prohibition?

explain.en: Don't plus verb forbids the action.
explain.id: Don't ditambah kata kerja melarang tindakan itu.

remediate.en: Prohibitions start with don't.
remediate.id: Larangan dimulai dengan don't.

questions.prompt: You hear: Listen and repeat. What do you do second?

explain.en: And joins two steps in order: listen first, repeat second.
explain.id: Kata and menyambung dua langkah berurutan: menyimak dulu, lalu mengulang.

remediate.en: Follow the order of the verbs you hear.
remediate.id: Ikuti urutan kata kerja yang kamu dengar.

board.title: Numbers you hear
board.formula: teen vs ty · price · phone number

segments.en: Fifteen and fifty. Sixteen and sixty.
segments.id: Kesalahan menyimak paling sering di A1 adalah pasangan teen dan ty.

segments.en: In fifteen the stress is at the end. In fifty the stress is at the front.
segments.id: Bedanya ada di tekanan. Fifteen ditekan di belakang, fifty ditekan di depan.

segments.en: It is twenty thousand rupiah. That is fifty thousand.
segments.id: Untuk harga, dengarkan angka besarnya dulu, baru satuannya.

segments.en: Phone numbers are read digit by digit.
segments.id: Nomor telepon dibaca satu per satu, bukan sebagai bilangan besar.

questions.prompt: You hear FIF-teen. Which number is it?

explain.en: Stress at the end means the teen number, 15.
explain.id: Tekanan di belakang berarti angka teen, yaitu 15.

remediate.en: Listen to which part is louder and longer.
remediate.id: Dengarkan bagian mana yang lebih keras dan panjang.

questions.prompt: How is the phone number 0812 read?

explain.en: Phone numbers are read digit by digit.
explain.id: Nomor telepon dibaca digit per digit.

remediate.en: Never group phone digits into big numbers.
remediate.id: Jangan menggabungkan digit telepon menjadi bilangan besar.

questions.prompt: You hear: It's fifty thousand. What is the price?

explain.en: Fifty is 50, so the price is 50,000.
explain.id: Fifty itu 50, jadi harganya 50.000.

remediate.en: Decide teen or ty first, then add the unit.
remediate.id: Tentukan teen atau ty dulu, baru tambahkan satuannya.

board.title: Directions you hear
board.formula: go straight · turn · it's on your left

segments.en: Go straight for two hundred metres, then turn right at the corner.
segments.id: Saat menyimak arah, tandai kata kerja perintahnya, bukan seluruh kalimat.

segments.en: Go, turn, take, cross.
segments.id: Empat kata kerja ini yang membawa instruksi utamanya.

segments.en: It is on your left, next to the bank.
segments.id: Kalimat terakhir biasanya menyebut posisi akhirnya.

segments.en: If you miss it, ask: Sorry, could you repeat that?
segments.id: Kalau tertinggal, mintalah pengulangan dengan could you repeat that.

questions.prompt: You hear: Turn right at the corner. What do you do?

explain.en: The instruction verb is turn, and the direction is right.
explain.id: Kata kerja perintahnya turn, dan arahnya right.

remediate.en: Catch the verb first, then the direction word.
remediate.id: Tangkap kata kerjanya dulu, baru kata arahnya.

questions.prompt: Which sentence tells you the final position?

explain.en: On your left describes where the place finally is.
explain.id: On your left menjelaskan posisi akhir tempatnya.

remediate.en: Position phrases start with on, next to or opposite.
remediate.id: Frasa posisi dimulai dengan on, next to, atau opposite.

questions.prompt: How do you ask someone to repeat?

explain.en: Could you repeat that, please? is the standard request.
explain.id: Could you repeat that, please? adalah permintaan bakunya.

remediate.en: Polite requests use could you.
remediate.id: Permintaan sopan memakai could you.

board.title: Asking politely
board.formula: Excuse me · Could you… · Sorry, I don't understand
examples: Excuse me, where is the bank?

segments.en: Excuse me, where is the bank?
segments.id: Excuse me adalah pembuka yang aman untuk bertanya kepada orang asing.

segments.en: Could you help me, please? Could you speak more slowly?
segments.id: Could you membuat permintaan terdengar sopan, lebih halus daripada can you.

segments.en: Sorry, I don't understand. Could you repeat that?
segments.id: Dua kalimat ini menyelamatkanmu saat percakapan terasa terlalu cepat.

segments.en: Thank you. You're welcome.
segments.id: Selalu tutup dengan terima kasih, dan kenali jawabannya you're welcome.

questions.prompt: How do you start a question to a stranger?

explain.en: Excuse me is the polite opener.
explain.id: Excuse me adalah pembuka yang sopan.

remediate.en: Openers matter as much as the question itself.
remediate.id: Kalimat pembuka sama pentingnya dengan pertanyaannya.

questions.prompt: What do you say if the speaker is too fast?
options: Could you speak more slowly, please?

explain.en: Could you plus please is the polite request form.
explain.id: Could you ditambah please adalah bentuk permintaan yang sopan.

remediate.en: Use could you for every polite request.
remediate.id: Pakai could you untuk setiap permintaan sopan.

questions.prompt: Someone says Thank you. What is the standard reply?

explain.en: You're welcome is the standard reply.
explain.id: You're welcome adalah jawaban bakunya.

remediate.en: Learn the pair: thank you and you're welcome.
remediate.id: Hafalkan pasangannya: thank you dan you're welcome.

board.title: Self introduction
board.formula: name · origin · job · nice to meet you

segments.en: Hello, my name is Jahran. I'm from Bandung. I'm a student.
segments.id: Perkenalan A1 punya tiga kalimat inti: nama, asal, dan pekerjaan.

segments.en: Say the three sentences in that order every time.
segments.id: Ucapkan ketiganya dalam urutan yang sama setiap kali, supaya menjadi refleks.

segments.en: Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you too.
segments.id: Penutupnya nice to meet you, dan jawabannya menambahkan kata too.

segments.en: And you? What about you?
segments.id: Setelah memperkenalkan diri, kembalikan pertanyaannya supaya percakapan berlanjut.

questions.prompt: Which sentence introduces your origin?

explain.en: From plus a place gives your origin.
explain.id: From ditambah nama tempat menyebut asalmu.

remediate.en: Origin always uses from.
remediate.id: Asal selalu memakai from.

questions.prompt: Someone says Nice to meet you. What do you reply?

explain.en: The standard reply adds too.
explain.id: Jawaban bakunya menambahkan kata too.

remediate.en: Mirror the greeting and add too.
remediate.id: Ulangi sapaannya dan tambahkan too.

questions.prompt: How do you return the question politely?

explain.en: And you? passes the turn back.
explain.id: And you? mengembalikan giliran bicara.

remediate.en: A short return question keeps the conversation going.
remediate.id: Pertanyaan balik yang pendek membuat percakapan berlanjut.

board.title: Ordering
board.formula: I'd like… · Can I have… · How much is it?

segments.en: I'd like a coffee, please. Can I have some water?
segments.id: Dua pola ini sudah cukup untuk memesan apa pun dengan sopan.

segments.en: I'd like is short for I would like.
segments.id: I'd like adalah singkatan dari I would like, dan terdengar lebih sopan daripada I want.

segments.en: How much is it? Can I have the bill, please?
segments.id: Untuk menanyakan harga pakai how much, dan untuk minta tagihan pakai the bill.

segments.en: For here or to take away?
segments.id: Petugas sering menanyakan ini. Artinya makan di tempat atau dibawa pulang.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is the most polite order?

explain.en: I'd like plus please is the polite standard.
explain.id: I'd like ditambah please adalah bentuk sopan yang baku.

remediate.en: I want sounds direct and impolite in a shop.
remediate.id: I want terdengar terlalu langsung dan kurang sopan di toko.

questions.prompt: How do you ask the price?

explain.en: Price is uncountable, so we ask how much.
explain.id: Harga tidak terhitung, jadi kita bertanya how much.

remediate.en: How many counts items, how much asks price.
remediate.id: How many menghitung benda, how much menanyakan harga.

questions.prompt: What does to take away mean?

explain.en: To take away means to take the food out of the shop.
explain.id: To take away berarti makanannya dibawa keluar.

remediate.en: For here means eating in the shop.
remediate.id: For here berarti makan di tempat.

board.title: Question types
board.formula: multiple choice · gap fill · true / false / not given

segments.en: Multiple choice, gap fill, and true, false or not given.
segments.id: Tiga bentuk soal ini yang paling awal kamu temui di kedua tes.

segments.en: In multiple choice, read every option before you answer.
segments.id: Dalam pilihan ganda, baca semua pilihan dulu. Pilihan pertama sering sengaja dibuat menggoda.

segments.en: In a gap fill, check the word class the gap needs.
segments.id: Dalam isian, periksa jenis kata yang dibutuhkan: kata benda, kata kerja, atau kata sifat.

segments.en: Not given means the text simply does not say.
segments.id: Not given berarti teksnya memang tidak menyebutkan, bukan berarti salah. Ini jebakan paling umum.

questions.prompt: In a true, false or not given task, the text does not mention the fact. The answer is…

explain.en: If the text does not say it, the answer is Not Given.
explain.id: Kalau teksnya tidak menyebutkan, jawabannya Not Given.

remediate.en: False means the text says the opposite.
remediate.id: False berarti teksnya menyatakan sebaliknya.

questions.prompt: What should you do first in a multiple choice question?

explain.en: Reading every option prevents the trap answer.
explain.id: Membaca semua pilihan mencegah terjebak pilihan pengecoh.

remediate.en: The first option is often deliberately attractive.
remediate.id: Pilihan pertama sering sengaja dibuat menarik.

questions.prompt: In a gap fill, what do you check before writing?

explain.en: Check whether the gap needs a noun, a verb or an adjective.
explain.id: Periksa apakah isiannya butuh kata benda, kata kerja, atau kata sifat.

remediate.en: Grammar decides which word can fit the gap.
remediate.id: Tata bahasa menentukan kata mana yang cocok untuk isian itu.

lessons.topic: TOEFL and IELTS: How the Tests Work

board.title: Exam orientation
board.formula: 4 skills: listening · reading · writing · speaking

segments.en: TOEFL and IELTS both test four skills: listening, reading, writing and speaking.
segments.id: Kedua tes ini menguji empat keterampilan yang sama. Itu sebabnya A1 pun sudah relevan.

segments.en: TOEFL iBT is taken on a computer. IELTS speaking is a face to face interview.
segments.id: Bedanya ada di formatnya. TOEFL lewat komputer, sedangkan speaking IELTS berupa wawancara langsung.

segments.en: Scores are bands or points, not pass or fail.
segments.id: Tidak ada lulus atau gagal. Yang ada adalah skor, jadi tugasmu menaikkan skornya.

segments.en: Your A1 foundation decides how fast you can move up.
segments.id: Fondasi A1 inilah yang menentukan seberapa cepat kamu bisa naik ke tingkat berikutnya.

questions.prompt: How many skills do TOEFL and IELTS test?

explain.en: Both test listening, reading, writing and speaking.
explain.id: Keduanya menguji listening, reading, writing, dan speaking.

remediate.en: Count the four skills.
remediate.id: Hitung keempat keterampilannya.

questions.prompt: Which test has a face to face speaking interview?

explain.en: IELTS speaking is an interview with an examiner.
explain.id: Speaking IELTS berupa wawancara dengan penguji.

remediate.en: TOEFL speaking is recorded on a computer.
remediate.id: Speaking TOEFL direkam lewat komputer.

questions.prompt: Can you fail TOEFL or IELTS?

explain.en: There is no pass or fail; you receive a score.
explain.id: Tidak ada lulus atau gagal; kamu menerima skor.

remediate.en: Institutions set the score they require.
remediate.id: Institusi yang menetapkan skor minimum yang dibutuhkan.

curriculum.note: Prototype scope: the A1 track is complete across every subject, because the product goal is a learner who can reach TOEFL / IELTS preparation. Higher levels are added on top of a finished A1, never instead of it.
